cohort: 1001 women delivering at a tertiary care center in Iowa from May to September 2020
finding: Women with obesity had a significantly increased odds of GDM and gHTN, and an increased risk of an infant with macrosomia, hypoglycemia, and NICU admission, but no significant association was found between BMI and COVID-19 infection or disease severity.
mod_finding: This study found that women with obesity had an increased risk of emergency cesarean section, but did not directly compare planned cesarean to vaginal delivery.
